assets.caption: Fig. B-1 — Typical Clamp Courtesy of Oteco Equipment Company
assets.description: Line drawing of a hub-and-clamp piping connector assembly. Labeled components include CLAMP BAR (top center), RELIEF GROOVE (right mid), SPHERICAL RECESSED SEAT (lower center), and SPHERICAL FACED NUT (lower left). The clamp is shown encircling two hub faces with bolts visible on both sides.
